senses.gloss: m. (careum, sub. cuminum, v. Sm. Ant. s. v.) כַּמּוֹנָא כ׳ caraway.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 29a:4">Ab. Zar. 29ᵃ</cite> (a remedy for nausea, v. <cite ref="A00775"><he>אוּנְקְלַי</he> I</cite>) <he>מייתי כ׳ כ׳</he> (Ar. <he>כרויא כמונא</he>, v. Koh. Ar. Compl. s. v. <he>כמן</he>, IV, p. 247, note 15) let him take caraway &c. [Rashi: (<cite ref="K00793"><he>כמון</he></cite>) <he>כמין כף אגרוף</he>, obviously a corruption of a Provençal word.]
